mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_ID, STOCK_ID, REQUESTER_ID, QUANTITY, STATUS FROM SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST WHERE INCIDENT_ID = #{incidentId} AND STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED') ORDER BY REQUEST_ID FOR UPDATE WAIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST WHERE INCIDENT_ID = #{incidentId} AND STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED')

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.INCIDENT_ID, R.STOCK_ID, S.DEPARTMENT_ID, D.NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, S.ITEM_ID, I.NAME AS ITEM_NAME, I.CATEGORY, I.UNIT, I.RETURNABLE, R.REQUESTER_ID, M.NAME AS REQUESTER_NAME, R.QUANTITY, R.STATUS, R.REASON, R.NEEDED_AT, R.CREATED_AT FROM SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST R JOIN SF_RESOURCE_STOCK S ON S.STOCK_ID = R.STOCK_ID JOIN SF_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPARTMENT_ID = S.DEPARTMENT_ID JOIN SF_RESOURCE_ITEM I ON I.ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID JOIN SF_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = R.REQUESTER_ID WHERE R.INCIDENT_ID = #{incidentId} AND R.STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED') ORDER BY R.REQUEST_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SF_RESOURCE_REQUEST WHERE INCIDENT_ID = #{incidentId} AND STATUS = 'DISPATCHED'
